title: Irumudi
plot_overview: Living peacefully beside a waterfall with his daughter, a man with an alcoholic past and history of violence takes on a 41-day spiritual vow at her request. The demanding period of austerity brings a new focus to their lives.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re drawn to stories about personal change, spiritual vows, and family bonds; Not for you if you prefer lighthearted plots or fast-paced action throughout.
review_summary: Pros: spiritual premise; father-daughter bond | Cons: limited plot details; no review consensus
